metadata.title: त्रिपुरा में जातीय हिंसा के ज़ख्म | Ethnic Violence in Tripura
metadata.description: In Gandatwisa, tensions escalated between the Tribal and Bengali communities following the tragic death of Parmeshwar Reang, a young Tribal student, on July 12. The ensuing violence left 145 families displaced, highlighting deep-seated divisions between the two communities. Political leaders from various parties rushed to visit the family of the deceased student and the affected residents. Yet, the Chief Minister of the BJP-led state government was notably the last to arrive. It took him over 15 days to address the crisis in person, further intensifying the community's grievances. Watch this ground report to understand how a student’s death exposed the underlying fault lines between the Tribal and Bengali populations in the state.
